description: This file extends the standard pickle.Pickler class to support serialization of dynamically defined functions, classes, and other complex objects for distributed computing frameworks like PySpark, Dask, and Ray. It includes custom reducers, state management, and utility functions for pickling objects that are not normally serializable, with a focus on inter-process communication.

classes.name: Pickler
classes.description: A custom subclass of pickle.Pickler with extended functionality for serializing complex and dynamically defined objects, including custom reducers and state management.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Serializes an object and writes it into a file-like object using the custom Pickler.

methods.name: dumps
methods.description: Serializes an object into a byte string in memory using the custom Pickler.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Deserializes an object from a byte stream.

methods.name: loads
methods.description: Deserializes an object from a byte string.
